body:
Deal: 15% off Storewide + $9.99 Delivery ($0 C&C / $69 Order) @ Milligram

[Frozensage] Are their paper and note books better than anko?
[ONEMariachi] Milligram stocks tonnes of brands.
What do you use your notebooks for?
I personally love travellers notebooks. Extremely fountain pen friendly. The standard midori notebooks are fantastic too.
It really depends on how much you enjoy the process of writing really.
I imagine a lot of people would never notice the difference.
[Fappo] I found a great deal on Amazon recently.
https://amzn.asia/d/05N6KwNt
500 sheets of Maruman B5 paper for $26. Really nice paper for fountain pens. I mostly prefer spiral bound or loose leaf paper so it was a great deal for me. 500 sheets should keep me going for quite a while.
[ONEMariachi] Yeah nice. I do similar with watercolour paper to put in my travellers notebook. Works well with the bands it uses
